title: Approval resume payload
description: The `payload` the SPA sends in `RunAgentInput.resume[]` when answering an approval interrupt of propose_document_changes or propose_child_items. Use the interrupt's `id` ("af-call-...") as `interruptId` - NOT its `toolCallId`; map to the tool call via `interrupt.toolCallId`; the original arguments are in `interrupt.metadata.agent_framework.function_call.arguments`. To reject, send approved=false and state.preview=null in the same request. To cancel send a resume entry with status "cancelled" (see resume-entry).

approved.description: true approves the tool call (with editedArgs, if present); false rejects it.

editedArgs.description: Full REPLACEMENT of the tool arguments (never merged): all argument keys, with only the accepted sections/children, including the user's edits. Must be a subset of the original proposal (checked by id). Validated against the tool's args schema. Omit to approve the proposal unchanged.
